coverage: For each seen class, mean of max (cos+1)/2 from all accessible globals to retained same-class globals, then class macro average; scarce subset same class average. Cos blocks256 rows.
scarcity: lower empirical third: quantile(counts,1/3,interpolation=lower), include ties; actual arrived shadow support counts or legal formal observed counts; not HK tail<250
local_coverage: Per retained global parent: average best mapped cosine from that same parent available local views to retained local views; absent available or retained locals0; average over retained parents. No cross-parent local matching.
redundancy: For each class, average off-diagonal cosine of retained globals; singleton0; then mean over classes; singleton-class fraction audited.
probability_margin_entropy: Candidate bags only, true labels legal TRAIN; macro over all seen classes; C1 margin and entropy0.
age: Actual simulated/real arrival age; average age/(1+age) over retained parent globals.
missing_values: No NaN imputation; masks/coverage ensure each seen class global count>=1; empty locals0, C1 entropy0; counts for unseen classes never in vector.
